How to Get a MoonPie Account

  1. Go tocloudmoonapp.com. Use a device without web filters if blocked.
  2. Sign up using your Google account.
  3. Press your profile icon top right → Set Up Password.
  4. Create a password you can remember...
  5. Return here and log in.
